Please create an illustration of Hoshimori Nemuri. Reference image ⬇️ Pinned post https://x.com/hoshimorinemuri?s=21 【Character】 ・A fairy-like VTuber with a fluffy, ethereal vibe ・Pastel color palette ・Long hair (soft texture) ・Star, moon, and dreamy cute motifs ・Small wings or fairy elements

Please draw her wearing an oversized white dress shirt, and nothing else. It should be slightly falling off her shoulders. She is lying down on a bed. She has a smirk and a flirty expression on her face.

Please note that she is short and small and flat.

This would be used as an illustration for my social media!

Thank you for your consideration! Please use any reference you like.
